Begin neurostim patch setup." • Create Task: Patch Calibration & Usage Training (Due in 3 days)
The Response should contain only these list of activities and no additional details.
c.Identify the article-chunk(s) most relevant to the query Extract the Source Id of the matched article Generate a concise response based on the content.
d. Final Touches make sure the language is clear, professional and polite. Language: English only Output only the List of activities for a clinical Trial in the given format.
